major_cooldowns.name: Avatar
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast on cooldown roughly every 90 seconds to boost all damage done and accelerate Thunder Clap; sync the first cast with Bloodlust and on-use trinkets for maximum burst overlap.

major_cooldowns.name: Demoralizing Shout
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown to reduce incoming damage and, with the Booming Voice talent, generate a burst of rage and deal damage; treat it as a frequent offensive cooldown rather than only a defensive.

major_cooldowns.name: Shield Charge
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown to charge the target, granting Shield Block and a stun while dealing burst damage; this is talent-gated, so a missing cast may be normal if Shield Charge was not taken.

major_cooldowns.name: Ravager
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop on the boss on cooldown when talented for a strong burst of AoE damage and rage generation; talent-gated, so do not flag missing casts for builds that skip it.

major_cooldowns.name: Demolish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: As a Colossus build, cast on cooldown at 3 or more stacks of Colossal Might for a large burst of single-target damage; talent-gated to the Colossus hero tree.

major_cooldowns.name: Champion's Spear
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Throw on cooldown when talented to tether and damage the target; talent-gated, so only flag missed casts for builds that selected it.

defensives.name: Shield Wall
defensives.usage_rule: Press proactively to smooth out a large spike of incoming damage or a tankbuster; its long cooldown means plan its use around the heaviest damage events of the fight.

defensives.name: Last Stand
defensives.usage_rule: Use to instantly gain a large block of temporary health when you are about to drop dangerously low; pairs well with a heal landing inside the window.

defensives.name: Rallying Cry
defensives.usage_rule: Use as a raid cooldown to grant the whole group temporary health before an unavoidable burst of raid-wide damage.

defensives.name: Spell Reflection
defensives.usage_rule: Press just before a reflectable magic cast or tankbuster to reduce magic damage taken and bounce single-target spells back at the caster.

defensives.name: Shield Block
defensives.usage_rule: Keep close to 100% uptime by refreshing whenever it has 10 seconds or less remaining to block incoming physical melee damage.

defensives.name: Ignore Pain
defensives.usage_rule: Dump excess rage into this absorb to avoid wasting rage and to soften physical and magic spikes; keep rage below the cap by spending into it.

defensives.name: Impending Victory
defensives.usage_rule: Use when your health is low to deal damage and instantly heal a chunk of your maximum health; talent-gated, replacing the passive Victory Rush.

rules.description: Open with Charge into Avatar and cooldowns
rules.action: Always Charge into combat to enter melee with rage, then immediately begin cycling Avatar, Demolish or Shield Slam, and Thunder Clap so your cooldowns start chaining as early as possible.

rules.description: Press Shield Slam on every cooldown
rules.action: Cast Shield Slam the instant it is available; it is your highest-value button for rage, threat, and damage, and any delay stalls your entire rotation.

rules.description: Use Avatar on cooldown every 90 seconds
rules.action: Cast Avatar on cooldown roughly every 90 seconds rather than holding it; banking it past its cooldown loses damage and Thunder Clap cooldown reduction over the fight.
Cast Thunder Clap on cooldown to apply and refresh the Rend damage-over-time bleed; never let Rend fall off the boss while it is active.

rules.description: Spend excess rage on Ignore Pain
rules.action: Dump spare rage into Ignore Pain whenever you approach the rage cap so you never waste generation; capping rage is a direct loss of survivability and damage.
Keep a button pressed on every global cooldown; missing 10 to 20 percent of your casts compounds into lost rage, less cooldown reduction, and significantly lower damage.
Start weaving Execute on targets at or below 20 percent health, or 35 percent if you took the Massacre talent, prioritizing it over filler spenders.

rules.description: Use Revenge as your AoE filler
rules.action: On three or more targets, use Revenge as your rage spender between Shield Slam and Thunder Clap; the core rotation already cleaves, so no major rotational change is needed.

source_summary: Protection Warrior plays a fast, rage-driven priority rotation built around pressing Shield Slam and Thunder Clap on cooldown while dumping excess rage into Ignore Pain. The major offensive cooldowns - Avatar, Demoralizing Shout, and the talented Shield Charge, Ravager, or Demolish - are used on cooldown rather than pooled, with Avatar synced to Bloodlust for the strongest burst. Survivability is layered: keep Shield Block near 100 percent uptime and save Shield Wall, Last Stand, and Rallying Cry for the fight's heaviest damage spikes.
